# JooEvents API documentation

> Public guides for organizers, operators, and third-party API integrators. JooEvents does not host an agent-direct surface; API paths in agent examples belong to the organizer's own installation.

## API integrations

- [Connect through the API](https://docs.jooevents.com/agents/quickstart.md): Safely create and configure a key, then orient an external agent.
- [External API operating model](https://docs.jooevents.com/agents/operating-model.md): Direct reads, human-approved plans, availability, outcomes, and recovery.
- [External API recipes](https://docs.jooevents.com/agents/recipes.md): Discovery-first call sequences for common agent work.

## Installation and operation

- [Install the browser sample](https://docs.jooevents.com/installation/browser-sample.md): Run the synthetic browser-local sample; it is not a production installation.
- [Cloudflare demo guide](https://docs.jooevents.com/operator/cloudflare-demo.md): Deploy the synthetic demo with Cloudflare controls.

## Reference

- [Licensing](https://docs.jooevents.com/reference/licensing.md): License information for this release.

## Optional

- [Product walkthrough](https://jooevents.com/): Public product overview.
